options.text: The body absorbs ultrasound and re-emits it at different frequencies
Ultrasound pulses are sent into the body and reflections from tissue boundaries are detected
Ultrasound creates an X-ray image of internal structures
Ultrasound passes through the body and is detected on the other side

questions.explanation: In ultrasound imaging, pulses of ultrasound are sent into the body. When these pulses reach a boundary between different tissues, some of the ultrasound is reflected back. The time delay and intensity of the reflections are used to build up an image of internal structures.
